name: reported-alias
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING name AS "item's version";

name: alias-exact
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING name AS version;

name: alias-quoted
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING name AS "version";

name: alias-bare
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING name version;

name: alias-bare-quoted
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING name "version";

name: qualifier-only
sql: UPDATE items AS version SET name = 'changed' RETURNING version.name;

name: function-name
sql: UPDATE items SET name = left(version(), 0) || 'changed';

name: cast-type
sql: UPDATE items SET name = CAST('changed' AS version);

name: postfix-type
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'::version;

name: typed-literal
sql: UPDATE items SET name = version 'changed';

name: collation-name
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' COLLATE version;

name: longer-identifier
sql: UPDATE items AS conversion SET name = 'changed';

name: quoted-assignment
sql: UPDATE items SET "version" = "version" + 1;

name: unquoted-assignment
sql: UPDATE items SET version = version + 1;

name: predicate-only
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' WHERE version = 0;

name: qualified-predicate
sql: UPDATE items AS i SET name = 'changed' WHERE i."version" = 0;

name: returned-reference
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING "version" AS v;

name: function-argument
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING abs(version);

name: delete-reference
sql: DELETE FROM items WHERE "version" = -1;

name: qualified-returned
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING items."version";
